name: Bottom Half Blocker
description: Tablet/laptop mode toggle for the ThinkPad X1 Fold 16. Covers the keyboard half of the built-in screen with a black overlay, keeps windows, the overview, the lock screen and shell dialogs in the visible half, and tells the tablet-mode daemon (org.probos.TabletMode) so GNOME switches its tablet mode too. Toggle by clicking the panel icon or with Super+Shift+T. Based on the Bottom Half Blocker extension by somefoo (GPL-3.0).
